query: Support agent on my site. It can search knowledge and email the customer, but ask me before sending.
expected_behavior: Use FLOWRA_CREATE_OR_UPDATE_AGENT via MULTI_EXECUTE, not a static workflow graph.
createEmbedWidget true because they asked for the site. Show embedScript and viewFlowUrl.
Pin only ACTION slugs from DISCOVER. Enable capabilities.humanApproval on the send slug.
Agent testMode true on FLOWRA_EXECUTE_WORKFLOW is a dry-run (no LLM, no credits). testMode false is billed and needs an explicit yes.
Do not put session inside the CREATE_OR_UPDATE_AGENT arguments.
